tasks.name: reverse_words
tasks.spec: returns the words of a sentence in reverse order
reqs: Words are separated by single spaces.

tasks.name: count_vowels
tasks.spec: counts the vowels in a string
reqs: Treat a, e, i, o, u as vowels, in any case.

tasks.name: is_palindrome
tasks.spec: checks whether a string reads the same backwards

tasks.name: merge_sorted
tasks.spec: merges two sorted lists into one sorted list
reqs: Do not call sorted() or list.sort().

tasks.name: flatten
tasks.spec: flattens a nested list of integers

tasks.name: running_mean
tasks.spec: returns the running mean of a list of numbers
reqs: The i-th output is the mean of the first i+1 inputs.

tasks.name: word_counts
tasks.spec: counts how often each word appears in a text

tasks.name: chunk
tasks.spec: splits a list into chunks of a given size
reqs: The last chunk may be shorter.

tasks.name: second_largest
tasks.spec: returns the second largest distinct number in a list
reqs: Return None if it does not exist.

tasks.name: caesar
tasks.spec: applies a Caesar shift to lowercase letters

tasks.name: unique_in_order
tasks.spec: removes duplicates from a list while keeping the first occurrence order

tasks.name: digit_sum
tasks.spec: returns the sum of the digits of a non-negative integer
reqs: Do not convert the number to a string.

tasks.name: transpose
tasks.spec: transposes a rectangular matrix given as a list of lists
reqs: Return a new list of lists.

tasks.name: binary_search
tasks.spec: finds the index of a target in a sorted list
reqs: Return -1 if the target is missing.

tasks.name: capitalize_words
tasks.spec: capitalizes the first letter of every word in a sentence

tasks.name: pairwise_diff
tasks.spec: returns the differences between consecutive numbers in a list
reqs: The output is one element shorter than the input.

tasks.name: longest_word
tasks.spec: returns the longest word in a sentence
reqs: Return the first one if there is a tie.

tasks.name: rotate_left
tasks.spec: rotates a list to the left by k positions
reqs: k can be larger than the list length.

tasks.name: count_primes
tasks.spec: counts the prime numbers below n

tasks.name: run_length
tasks.spec: run-length encodes a string
reqs: Write each run as the character followed by its count.
